text:
caroline: Heads-up — sampleapp onboarding hit a nasty bundler/edge combo. Vite dev works but Vite build + Vercel Edge deploy crashes with the SDK. Repro steps + logs below.

mike: Ugh. Can you paste the error?

caroline: Error on the Edge runtime: 
```
TypeError: Cannot redefine property: exports
    at Object.defineProperty (<anonymous>)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/var/task/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js:12:15)
    at __webpack_require__ (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:25:42)
    at Module.<anonymous> (bootstrap_node.js:559:3)
```

caroline: But local vite dev (vite) logs show a different problem during prerender: 
```
Uncaught SyntaxError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/cjs/index.js' does not provide an export named 'createClient'
```

sasha: So Vite is resolving to the CJS path in the package's exports map during build. That happens when bundlers pick the wrong entry for SSR/build.

andre: Which version of the SDK are you on? There were a couple exports/exports.mjs changes.

caroline: Using @redwood/inference-js@2.1.0-canary.2026.03.20. Pinning to 2.0.4 avoids the defineProperty crash but then the types mismatch.

zoe: Types? What TS error do you see?

caroline: TS error during tsc on CI: 
```
src/inferenceClient.ts:12:7 - error TS2322: Type 'Client' is not assignable to type 'ClientConstructor'.
12 const client = new InferenceClient(opts)
         ~~~~~~
  src/types/index.d.ts:45:5
    45 export interface ClientConstructor {
         ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
  The types exported from the package don't match the runtime shape (class vs factory).
```

mike: Ok, this is multiple issues: (1) package exports map falling back to CJS for some bundlers, (2) CJS package mutates exports causing defineProperty fail in Edge sandbox, (3) typedefs exporting an interface that doesn't match actual constructor signature.

caroline: I put a tiny repro in a gist: https://gist.github.com/caro/abcd1234 with a minimal app, vite.config, and package.json demonstrating behavior. Repro commands: 
1) git clone gist + npm i
2) npm run build (vite)
3) npx vercel dev --edge or deploy to Vercel (Edge)

sasha: I reproduced on Rollup + SvelteKit too. Rollup's resolver picks the package.exports -> default to CJS because of incorrectly ordered priority in exports.

andre: Workarounds for now: 
- For Vite: set ssr.noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] so Vite preserves ESM path.
- For Rollup/webpack: alias '@redwood/inference-js' -> '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js' in bundler config.
- For Vercel Edge: prefer the ESM entry by explicitly importing the ESM file: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'`.

zoe: Also, adding a small build-time shim helps: in your app root, create `shims/redwood-esm.js` with `export * from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/esm/index.js'` and alias the package to that. Ugly but works while upstream fixes.

caroline: Filed internal bug: infra-inference#2289 with reproduction and logs. Linking here for triage: https://redwood.internal/issue/2289. @dev-bot kicked off a CI run.

dev-bot: CI run started for infra-inference#2289 — build matrix: vite/rollup/webpack.

mike: For the typings issue I can hack a local patch: change `types/index.d.ts` to export `export class InferenceClient { constructor(opts?: any) }` rather than `interface ClientConstructor`. That should match runtime.

andre: Long-term fix plan: 
1) Normalize package.json `exports` so ESM entry is picked by browser/edge/bundlers first. Add explicit `import`/`require` fields.
2) Ensure CJS build avoids mutating exports (don't redefine properties).
3) Publish a patch release and backport to 2.0.x for customers pinned to older versions.
4) Fix .d.ts to reflect real runtime API and add a TS smoke test in CI.

sasha: I'll add CI test jobs to reproduce with Vite build + `vercel dev --edge` and a rollup target. We should also smoke test `npm pack` + bundler to catch packaging regressions.

caroline: Thanks. For now I've added the `ssr.noExternal` entry to sampleapp and updated onboarding docs with the alias workaround. Leaving repro + gist + stack traces in the ticket.

zoe: Great. Can someone add a short note to the SDK release notes and the onboarding guide so users hitting this won't get stuck?

mike: I'll draft the release note and a small migration snippet for the docs. :+1:

caroline: Appreciate the quick help. If anyone wants the minimal repro repo (with SvelteKit + Next + plain Vite builds) I can push to the infra-inference org.

andre: Please do. Tag me and I'll assign for the exports/type fixes.

zoe: marking follow-ups: docs, ci-smoke, packaging.

caroline: closing loop here — will keep thread updated once patch lands.
